predictor.notes: Retained the original predictor; additional observations do not support changing it. Approved quotes and exports in the second session again returned exactly 121250 cents at quantity 50 and 320000 cents at quantity 200, matching the first session. Additional probes at quantities 125, 750, and 1000 yielded denials, not prices. This predictor covers 1..1000 and exactly matches both observed price points, but all other quantities remain unverified. Nonlinear and piecewise alternatives cannot be excluded: 60000 + 1200*q + 0.5*q*q also matches both observed prices. Exact reconstruction and error bounds elsewhere are not identifiable from the available observations. Cumulative usage: 32 of 192 business requests and 4 of 48 REA operations.
